2. The present application under Section 483 Cr.P.C. has been filed with a prayer to direct the court concerned to decide the Case No.56/IX/2022 (State Vs. Sumit and others) arising out of Case Crime No.32 of 2021 under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and 3,4 D.P. Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Mathura pending in the Court of Civil Judge (J.D.), Fast Tract Court (Against Women Offences) / Judicial Magistrate, Mathura, expeditiously within a stipulated period.

sentences.text: 3. It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the aforesaid case is pending since 2022.
Applicant is the informant in this case.
Presently the trial is at the stage of summoning of the accused / opposite parties no.2 to 4.
Applicant is regularly appearing on the dates fixed by the trial court, but the accused / opposite parties are trying to linger on the matter.

More than three years from the date of lodging of the F.I.R. have been passed but no proper trial proceedings have been initiated for expeditious disposal of the case and the applicant is facing immense hardship and problem.
In spite of bailable warrants, the accused are not appearing before the court concerned.

sentences.text: In the present matter, from the perusal of the order-sheets it appears after passing the summoning order, several dates were fixed for the appearance of the accused / opposite parties no.2 to 4 to appear before the court.
The court also issued several process, but they did not appear.
Since the appearance of the accused has not been procured so far by the trial court, this Court thinks it proper to issue a direction to the trial court for the expeditious disposal of the case.

5. Considering the facts and circumstance of the case, the trial court is directed to make all possible efforts and to use its power attributed to it by law to procure the attendance of the accused before the court and after procuring the appearance of the accused, the trial court is directed further to make all possible endeavours to dispose of the case under reference within a period of two years, if there is no other legal impediment.
6.

It is also made clear that the Court / Presiding Officer is not the only stake holder in the trial and disposal of a case, hence, besides the P.O. concerned, all the stake holders i.e. police and executive authorities, counsels, parties to the case, staff etc. are also made bound by this order and it will be their responsibility also to assist the Court in every manner for the expeditious disposal of this case.
7. With these observations, the application is finally disposed of.
